title: the official unbeatabletwtcord minecraft resource pack
description: Unofficial official resource pack for the unbeatabletwtcord!!!
body:
resource pack changes:
*  :quaver_evil:  diamonds
* 1/22: music discs replaced by cassettes (created by Penny)
* jukeboxes replaced by animated cassette player
*  UNBEATABLE main menu logo
*  flip phone spyglass (todo: add sound)
* turtle, scutes, and turtle helmet replaced by roomba (created by Evelyn)
* heavy core and mace replaced by Beat's microphone (3D model by Milk)
* ancient debris replaced by HARM dampener
* netherite replaced by penny
* netherite block has animated penny
* netherite helmet replaced by animal ears
* diamond helmet replaced by ribbon
* wither skeleton and wither replaced by Nothing
* nether star replaced by S+ rank
* beacon has animated clef
* redstone dust and redstone block replaced by Poco
* eye of ender replaced by quaver's poster
* end portal frame replaced by HARM posters
* dragon egg replaced by quaver plush
* end crystal replaced by zero moment portal
* elytra replaced by guitar case
* end flashes now feature quaver plush
* custom end poem
* custom item names
* custom achievement names and descriptions
* custom death messages
* custom main menu splash text
(note: custom text is only for the US and GB english language settings)

paintings:
* beat idle (1x2) replacing "graham"
* quaver idle (1x2) replacing "prairie ride"
* clef idle (1x2) replacing "wanderer"
* poco idle (2x2) replacing "the stage is set"
* downwards speech bubble (1x1) replacing "wasteland"
* sideways speech bubble (1x1) replacing "target sucessfully bombed"
* apoco posing (2x1) replacing "seaside"
* poco posing (2x1) replacing "creebet"
* "quaver" graffiti (2x1) replacing "bonjour monsieur corbet"
* quaver V :quaver_v:  (2x2) replacing "wither"
* quaver plush (4x4) by @bobble.hat  replacing "skull on fire"
